findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a design part closes its redraw, runs a follow-up work round, and closes again.
The test still accepts any close error other than the two checked strings and never verifies that the passed cold read survives. Its GitHub fixture returns an empty PR list but supplies no response for `gh pr create`; unmatched calls fail in tests/conftest.py:117-136, while a successful close needs that call at src/forge/close.py:980-988. Thus the test can pass without either close completing. It would also pass with a stale read record, although src/forge/story.py:789-793 would reject the redrawn plan. Check the close outcomes and the preserved read at the command boundary.
